t: A ROS robot car kit with a six-joint arm, lidar, and depth camera.
steps: Buy a kit from the Hiwonder store or RobotShop. Choose a kit with a main computer included to skip flashing your own system image.
Charge the battery pack with the included charger.
Follow the Quick Start Guide on the Hiwonder wiki to power on and check the arm and wheels.
Drive the robot with the phone app or remote to learn how it moves.
Connect to the robot over Wi-Fi from a laptop and open its desktop.
Run the lidar mapping lesson and save a map of one room.
Try the navigation lesson and send the robot to a point on that map.
Move on to the color tracking and arm lessons in the wiki.
meta: Open Board. From $780. A few stores.
